issues: 工作台按 110f 截断，正好切在全字提亮之前，标题从没被完整点亮过
光锥是 clip-path 硬边梯形，边缘像剪纸；光斑是纯灰白圆，没有灯光的色温
光斑 x 是纯正弦，f110 正以最高速穿过中心时被硬停，收尾一顿
平铺 #2a2a28 灰底、Helvetica、标题是卡名 "SPOTLIGHT ON" 的占位
changes: 补 SPOTLIGHT_SWEEP_REVEAL_DURATION = 160（f125 起真静止 35f），完整演到全亮定格
光锥改为 SVG 柔边体积光（灯头在画外正上方，近灯头 0.20、往下渐隐，16px 高斯柔边），光束里 48 粒尘埃缓慢上浮闪烁；墙上光斑改为暖白（255,244,228）横椭圆，被照到的字底下垫一层同遮罩的 14px 柔晕
摆动保留 560px·sin(2πf/55) 两来回，乘一个从 f27 起 smooth 收拢的阻尼包络，光斑在 f110 以零速度停到中心再交给提亮
底色改为 #17181d→#0b0c0f 带色相的深色渐变 + 重暗角 + 静态颗粒；标题换成 "Your best work, / in the spotlight."（系统 SF 栈 150px/800 负字距），暗版 0.07、全亮 out-cubic、光效线性消散的参数不变
issuesEn: The workbench cut it at 110f, right before the full reveal, so the title was never fully lit
The beam was a hard-edged clip-path trapezoid like cut paper, and the pool was a flat grey-white circle with no colour temperature
The pool's x was a pure sine, so at f110 it stopped dead while crossing centre at top speed, leaving a hitch at the end
Flat #2a2a28 grey, Helvetica, and the title was the card-name placeholder "SPOTLIGHT ON"
changesEn: Added SPOTLIGHT_SWEEP_REVEAL_DURATION = 160 (truly still for 35f from f125), so it now plays through to the fully lit hold

The beam is now soft SVG volumetric light (lamp off-frame directly above, 0.20 near the lamp fading downward, 16px Gaussian edge) with 48 dust motes drifting up and twinkling; the pool is a warm-white (255,244,228) horizontal ellipse, and lit glyphs get a 14px soft glow under the same mask
The swing keeps two 560px·sin(2πf/55) passes but multiplies them by a damping envelope that eases in from f27, so the pool arrives at centre at zero velocity on f110 before handing off to the reveal

Background is a hue-tinted #17181d→#0b0c0f gradient with a heavy vignette and static grain; the title is now "Your best work, / in the spotlight." (system SF stack, 150px/800, negative tracking); the 0.07 dark copy, out-cubic reveal and linear light fade are unchanged
